description: This file is a script for profiling memory usage (specifically peak RSS) of extension entry points in a project. It includes functions to parse command-line arguments, run child processes with specified environment variables, and generate reports on memory consumption, making use of Node.js modules for filesystem and process management.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the profiling script.

methods.name: parsePositiveInt
methods.description: Parses a string argument into a positive integer, throwing an error if invalid.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into an options object for the profiling process.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Extracts the maximum RSS value in MB from stderr output containing a specific marker.

methods.name: summarizeStderr
methods.description: Creates a short summary of the stderr output, limiting to the first few lines.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a child Node.js process with specified environment and inputs, returns profiling results.

methods.name: buildImportBody
methods.description: Constructs the JavaScript code to import extension files, used to profile memory.

methods.name: findExtensionEntries
methods.description: Reads the extensions directory and returns a list of built extension entry points.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that gathers extension entries, runs memory profiling, and generates reports.
